_comment: Editorial content for PASL. Every fact is attributable - see sourceNote. No image attached: no licence-cleared photograph of the company's own premises exists. pasl.com.pk is the live site; the annual report still cites the older pervezahmed.net, which no longer resolves.
description: Pervez Ahmed Consultancy Services Limited is a listed investment company and brokerage firm that began operations in November 2005, was listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange on 25 April 2007, and is a TREC holder of the Pakistan Stock Exchange. It describes its core activities as equity investments, securities brokerage, underwriting, corporate finance and research, with paid-up capital of Rs. 600 million. The company sits within the D.S. Group, and its registered office is at 20-K, Gulberg II, Lahore.
sourceNote: Written from: Pervez Ahmed Consultancy Services Ltd. website (pasl.com.pk: about, profile, services, contacts) and the company's Annual Report for the year ended 30 June 2025 - company information and vision/mission (pasl.com.pk/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/PASL-Annual-Report-2024-25.pdf) (accessed 2026-10-17)
